data.content: # Jaguars vs Bengals predictions, picks, odds: Who wins Week 4 NFL game? Two explosive offenses square off today in Cincinnati when the Jacksonville Jaguars play the Bengals. One will rise to the level of true contender in the AFC, while the other falls back to .500 and will have to deal with some big questions. For the Jaguars, the big one remains: "Is this for real?" Jacksonville bounced back after falling flat in Denver with a resounding 35-6 victory over the New England Patriots. Trevor Lawrence has taken great care of the ball so far this year, with three touchdowns in the win giving him seven on the year against just two interceptions. That's likely to change against the Bengals, who have been held to just 20 one time this year. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park.
